steps.title: EXPORTING

plans.name: DATASET
plans.desc: The process begins with entering manual trades and marking key market situations on charts. Every entry, exit, and market context is automatically recorded and stored in a clear, structured format. This gradually builds a structured dataset ready for AI training.

plans.name: TRAINING
plans.desc: The model is trained using the created dataset, in which AI analyses patterns in trading decisions. The system learns to recognise specific market conditions in which a position is entered or held. The result is a model that faithfully captures the selected trading approach and strategy logic.

plans.name: TESTING
plans.desc: Testing is the process of evaluating the trained model on historical data outside the training sample. Its success rate, stability, and behaviour across different market phases are assessed in detail. This stage verifies the model's reliability before it is deployed in live operation.

plans.name: EXPORT
plans.desc: After testing is complete, the final model is exported to a compatible format (.pth). The model is then ready for direct implementation in MetaTrader 4/5 as a fully functional trading tool. In real time, it can monitor market developments and evaluate trading opportunities according to its learned rules.
